Callout.Name: Sports Injury
Callout.Message: Player injured on a pitch, suspected leg fracture.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, leg deformed, coaches keeping people back.

Script.Line: It was the tackle. Studs up, right on the shin.
I heard it crack before I felt anything.
Do not let them carry me off. I can hop, I have done it before.

Callout.Patient: I heard it crack. I am not walking off.

Lines.Approach: The leg is not straight and he is being very brave about it. Splint him and keep the crowd off.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
